metadata.task_name: User-Exit Extensibility — IUserExits, GXGeneratedPage, and JSFunctionsService

finding.preliminary_assessment: JSON.parse/stringify deep clone does not protect against prototype pollution from server-supplied data — a compromised ApplinX server could inject __proto__ keys in field or screenModel JSON to pollute Object.prototype in browser context.

patterns_observed: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify()) used as deep clone in GXGeneratedPage:42 and screen-processor:133-134
structuredClone() is the safe modern alternative available in all modern browsers and Node 17+
Object.assign in GXGeneratedPagesUtils.mergeScreens() may propagate __proto__ from polluted source

for_inquisitor: Test JSON.parse with __proto__ key in target browser environment to confirm whether prototype is actually polluted
Replace all JSON.parse(JSON.stringify()) clone patterns with structuredClone() which handles __proto__ safely
